1.title: Uriah Smith
1.text: The Lamb on Mount Zion represents Christ in His triumphant role. The 144,000 having the Father's name on their foreheads denotes a seal of absolute ownership, protection, and moral reflection of God's character.

7.title: Uriah Smith
7.text: The message to 'Fear God and give him glory' is the first angel's message, proclaiming the hour of God's judgment. It calls the world back to true worship of the Creator in contrast to the beast's worship.
